construction.reading: ORACLE never fetches on a PRESENT item, so its view is ALWAYS's byte for byte; 'correct stays flat' between them is an identity. The gated policies change the PRESENT view only by abstention (fewer answered) and by tagged fetched lines.

a_flat_correct.verdict: construction (ALWAYS vs ORACLE) + abstention over a persona-binding gap, bounded by retrieval rank

b_stale_rising_with_reach.verdict: reporting artifact: counts over a growing denominator; rates flat with overlapping Wilson intervals; stale answers arise only from active lines asserting the stale value (mini), plus five qualified mentions (Haiku)

c_haiku_above_mini.verdict: instrument: unscorable expiry (8 vs 1 of the registered 27 vs 17) plus qualified mentions in second sentences scored by a one-directional coverage detector; on 'gives the stale value' Haiku is at or below mini

d_inert_instruction.verdict: redundant for mini (answers byte-identical), mis-targeted for both: the instruction addresses tagged lines and the stale sources are active (untagged) lines

retrieval_config.lifecycle_mask: none (unmasked; TRUE lifecycle metadata printed on every line)
retrieval_config.query: the item's question text, embedded once with text-embedding-3-small (1536-d), pinned in resp_review/l2/question_emb.npz
retrieval_config.ranking: np.argsort(-cosine) (non-stable; ties beyond rank 10 could permute; the gate covers ranks 1-10)
retrieval_config.retriever: LifecycleBank.cosine_search_all (lifecycle_bank.py:402-414) over the item's store variant (resp_common.variant_ids), every entry active or not

identity.note: entries print 'User ...' (or a third party's name); the prompt says 'a question about a user from a view of the user's memory store' and never binds the persona's name to 'User'

view_step4b.negation_mistag_example: frbank:fatima:fatima_q06:FULL -- the retraction statement ('decided not to launch ... Oud and Geometry') carries the retracted tag (covers 4 of 5 original-plan tokens at 0.80; the join has no negation handling) while the plan records stay active ('launching' is not 'launch')
